mapper.select: select order_id, user_id, product_id, product_type, entitlement_snapshot, status, url, total_amount, product_name, valid_time, create_time, external_transaction_id from t_order where user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} AND status in (0, 1) AND valid_time > NOW() order by id desc limit 1

SELECT external_transaction_id FROM t_order WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND entitlement_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND external_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND NOW() >= create_time + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND NOW() >= COALESCE(update_time,create_time) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY COALESCE(update_time,create_time),id LIMIT 10
select order_id, user_id, product_id, product_type, status, url, total_amount, product_name, valid_time, create_time, external_transaction_id from t_order where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = 1, url=#{url}, external_transaction_id=#{externalTransactionId}, update_time = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 0;
UPDATE t_order SET status = 2, pay_time=#{payTime}, update_time = now(), creating_lock=null WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (0, 1);
